description: This file defines the WebSocketChannel class, which provides a transport-independent implementation of WebSockets, including connection management, frame sending/receiving, and handshake handling within the Chromium project.

classes.name: WebSocketChannel
classes.description: Transport-independent implementation of WebSockets, managing connection, data frames, handshake, and state transitions.

methods.name: SendAddChannelRequest
methods.description: Starts the connection process by sending a request to establish a WebSocket connection.

methods.name: SendFrame
methods.description: Sends a data frame to the remote WebSocket endpoint.

methods.name: StartClosingHandshake
methods.description: Initiates the closing handshake for the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: SendAddChannelRequestForTesting
methods.description: Starts connection with a specified callback, used for testing.

methods.name: SetClosingHandshakeTimeoutForTesting
methods.description: Sets the timeout for the closing handshake, used for testing.

methods.name: SetUnderlyingConnectionCloseTimeoutForTesting
methods.description: Sets the timeout for underlying connection close, used for testing.

methods.name: OnStartOpeningHandshake
methods.description: Called when the WebSocket opening handshake starts.
